snippets.title: Lhun on X: motion sickness advice for people getting into VR
snippets.snippet: Want to get into VR but you're worried about motion sickness? Not a problem: The mammalian poison rejection response is based on scent and taste. So, chew gum, and importantly, change the scent of the headset (really!) With this trick, it resets the feeling and you can try again.
